text:
maria: putting this here — UX review request for the routing policies editor. Triage focus: priority ordering UI, validation messages when rules conflict, and the preview/simulate flow. screenshot: https://img.example/priority-slate.png

alex: quick read — overall looks good. main thing: reordering needs keyboard affordance. drag handles alone won't pass a11y. suggest arrow-key move + visible focus ring.

jon: +1 on keyboard. also, can we show explicit numeric priority badges? visualizing order helps when there are >8 rules.

kelly: re: copy — current label "Priority" feels terse. options: "Evaluation order", "Rule priority", or "Execution rank". I prefer "Rule priority" for clarity.

maria: lean toward "Evaluation order" (because product docs use "evaluation" elsewhere) but open to consistency tradeoffs. important: validation copy when a rule is shadowed should explain why it's unreachable. current: "Rule will never match" is too terse.

sam: suggestion for unreachable validation text: `Rule cannot match because previous rule(s) have a superset condition. Consider reordering or editing conditions.` That's longer but actionable.

alex: +1 actionable. Small nit: use inline icon for validation (⚠️) and also show a "Why?" inline tooltip with a one-line example.

kelly: accessibility nit — tooltip needs to be keyboard-focusable and announced by screenreaders. add `aria-describedby` and ensure `role="tooltip"` and `aria-live="polite"` for dynamic messages.

maria: preview simulation — current prototype streams a sample request through rules and highlights the matched rule. request: allow toggling sample set and show a condensed trace (rule matched, KV cache hits, fallback). design-bot: preview run complete: 12 requests simulated, 10 hits, 2 fallbacks.

jon: for the trace UI, tiny timeline chips would be good: [req id] -> [rule 3] -> [model small] -> [fallback]. maybe collapsible per-request logs. keep default collapsed for perf.

kelly: copy tweaks for action buttons: rather than `Move up`/`Move down` use icons + `Raise`/`Lower`. but `Raise/Lower` might be ambiguous — prefer `Move earlier` / `Move later`. testers found "earlier/later" clearer.

maria: decisions / action items: 1) use numeric badge + drag handle, 2) add keyboard reorder (arrow keys + enter), 3) change field label to `Evaluation order` (product to confirm), 4) validation copy replace with sam's actionable text, 5) preview simulation: add sample set dropdown and compact trace. kelly to update mocks by EOD, alex to spike keyboard reorder, jon to spec telemetry for preview collapsed logs. any objections?

sam: no objections. sending quick copy PR after lunch. :thumbsup:

alex: will prototype keyboard moves and post a short gif here when ready.

kelly: mock uploaded: https://figma.example/redwood/routing-priority-v3 — includes focus states and tooltip behavior.

maria: perfect, thanks team. we'll reconvene after the spike. closing thread for now. :)
